entries.title: USDA RD Water System investment for City of Idabel and Broken Bow, Okla (20260901-USDA-RD-OK-JM-1006).jpg
entries.description: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Rural Development State Director for Oklahoma, Zachary Swartz, presents a $20.8 million water infrastructure investment to the mayor and city council members of Idabel on behalf of the Trump Administration during an investment ceremony Sept. 1, 2026, in Idabel, Okla. The city's public works authority will use this grant and loan investment from USDA to build a new water plant. More than $80 million in water infrastructure projects have been recently announced by USDA in southeast Oklahoma. USDA Media by Joel Mease.
entries.creator: USDAgov
